name: Stella X Public Company Limited
summary: Established in 1960 and headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand, Stella X Public Company Limited operates as a prominent property developer within the country. The company's diverse business endeavors are organized into three primary divisions: Property Development, Rental and Service, and Medical and Health. Within its core real estate segment, it focuses on the construction and sale of land, residential houses, and condominium units. Beyond property, Stella X also manages golf courses and hotels, invests in the hospital sector, and distributes various medical and healthcare products. Its expansive portfolio further includes the leasing of spaces and assets, operation of a travel agency, engagement in medical and technological ventures, and the provision of financial services. The company, formerly known as Nusasiri Public Company Limited, officially adopted the name Stella X Public Company Limited in December 2024.
